# proxmox_node_suspendall (Resource)

Suspends all guests of a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/suspendall` and waits for the worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_suspendall" "all" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to suspend again.

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum concurrent tasks.
- `vms` (Set of Number) Only suspend these VMIDs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
